dataset: Zhang et al. 2022 Nature Communications (doi:10.1038/s41467-022-33365-y) — 41467_2022_33365_MOESM6_ESM.xlsx + GSE200563
critical_forensic_correction_BC_definiti: In Zhang et al. 2022, 'BC' in Sheet 1 ('TBME vs. BC') stands for Brain Control / Normal Brain Cortex parenchyma (NOT Breast Cancer). All 191 negative Log2FC genes in TBME vs. BC are canonical neuronal/synaptic/myelin transcripts (SNAP25, SYT1, SYP, SLC1A2, PLP1, MAP2, SLC17A7, GRIN1). There is no breast comparison sheet in MOESM6_ESM.xlsx.

TBME vs. BC.description: Tumor Brain Microenvironment (TBME, peritumoral reactive brain around NSCLC BrM) vs. Brain Control/Cortex (BC, normal brain parenchyma). NOTE: Historical handoff misread 'BC' as Breast Cancer; the 191 negative Log2FC genes (SNAP25, SYT1, SYP,SLC1A2, PLP1, MAP2, SLC17A7, GRIN1) are canonical normal brain cortex neuronal/synaptic/oligodendrocyte transcripts lost in reactive TBME.

TIME-B vs. LB.description: Tumor Immune Microenvironment in Brain (TIME-B, peritumoral brain stroma/immune cuff) vs. Lung Brain Metastasis Tumor Core (LB). Positive Log2FC (n=165) = enriched in TIME-B cuff; Negative Log2FC (n=28) = enriched in LB malignant tumor core (LB > TIME-B).

TIME-L vs.L.description: Tumor Immune Microenvironment in Lung (TIME-L, primary lung peritumoral stroma) vs. Primary Lung Tumor Core (L). Positive Log2FC (n=153) = enriched in TIME-L stroma; Negative Log2FC (n=69) = enriched in L primary lung tumor core (L > TIME-L).

F(h) vs. F(-).description: Fibrotic-high (F(h), collagen-rich fibrotic BrM niche) vs. Fibrotic-low (F(-), astrocyte/glial-rich BrM niche). Positive Log2FC (n=69) = enriched in fibrotic F(h); Negative Log2FC (n=30) = enriched in glial/astrocytic F(-) (GFAP, CLU, AQP4, MBP, SLC1A2, S100B, ALDH1L1).
